note: Every named test that existed and passed before this wire corpus was added. The replay test re-scans the test sources and fails if any of these names disappears, so a later change cannot quietly drop or rename an existing test.

provenance.note: Recorded from the built stdio MCP executable before any dependency change. Regenerate with `node scripts/capture-premigration-baseline.mjs`. No capture timestamp is stored so that re-recording an unchanged build produces byte-identical files.
